name: bedrock-villager-editor
description: Unofficial desktop and CLI villager editor for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition (1.14 - 1.21.x) with patch-oriented NBT preservation, backups, rollback, trade editing, and a read-only world map.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-asset-manifest.js && tsc && node scripts/verify-public-js.js && node scripts/verify-renderer-contract.js && node scripts/copy-public.js && node scripts/verify-build.js
scripts.make:win:signed: node scripts/verify-release-signing.js && npm run build && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.release:verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:synthetic
scripts.release:verify:stable: node scripts/verify-release-metadata.js --stable && node scripts/verify-release-signing.js && npm run release:verify

author: cghxst
